newsitem.title: POLAND: Swarzedz surges 9.5 pct on debt deal.
newsitem.headline: Swarzedz surges 9.5 pct on debt deal.

text.p: Polish furniture maker Swarzedz SA surged 9.5 percent in active trade to 12.7 zlotys on Tuesday, the day after the firm signed a debt restructuring deal with creditors.

Under the agreement, half of the firm's almost 60 million zlotys debts to financial creditors would be paid off with equity. The 12.9 million zloty debt to suppliers would be paid from increased turnover derived from proceeds from investment from a planned rights issue.
The firm plans to issue 3,125,000 shares to creditors and 3.5 million rights, the latter raising about 30 million zlotys.
Traders said the debt restructuring news could help the stock extend gains on Wednesday.
